appearance: The selected hero is the dominant focal subject and is not cropped at the head, hands, or feet.
The title never crosses the hero face and occupies less than one fifth of screen height.
Class choices and launch controls form one compact group with an obvious selected state.
Phone portrait and landscape fit without scrolling; no control is hidden by browser safe areas.
All three character scenes use the same dark-gothic palette, lighting, camera language, and proportions.
The world is the dominant surface: no dashboard or black void competes with the playfield.
Buildings, props, ground, actors, and effects share one scale, perspective, palette, and light direction.
The player and nearby enemies are readable at actual play scale and never resemble attached scenery.
Mobile controls overlay the corners, remain at least 44 CSS pixels, and obscure at most one fifth of portrait height.
Health, enemy count, and abilities are readable without covering the player or central combat zone.
Movement, attacks, animation recovery, depth ordering, and camera follow look continuous across a frame sequence.
